claim: For Amazon OpenSearch Service No Upfront Reserved Instances (NURI), one-year NURIs offer a 31% discount and three-year NURIs offer a 48% discount compared to On-Demand Instance pricing; for T3.medium, one-year NURIs offer an 18% discount and three-year NURIs offer a 28% discount.

qualifiers.scope: No Upfront Reserved Instances; T3.medium has its own lower discounts
qualifiers.condition: You pay nothing upfront but commit to pay over a one- or three-year term.

evidence.quote: No Upfront Reserved Instances (NURI) – NURIs offer significant savings compared to On-Demand Instance pricing. You pay nothing upfront, but you commit to pay for the Reserved Instances over the course of a one- or three-year term. One-year NURIs offer a 31% discount and three-year NURIs offer a 48% discount. For T3.medium, one-year NURIs offer a 18% discount and three-year NURIs offer a 28% discount.
